subject: Insurance
title: Self-Driving Cars and Liability
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Self-Driving Cars and Liability.

buildup.text: Traditional auto insurance assumes a human driver.

discovery.text: Some proposals shift liability entirely to manufacturers.

twist.text: Tesla's autopilot has been involved in hundreds of crashes. The company blames drivers for not paying attention.

climax.text: Autonomous vehicles will fundamentally restructure auto insurance.

punchline.text: The car drives, who's liable? Autonomous vehicles break the insurance model.

quiz.question: What liability question do self-driving cars raise?
options: Whether the manufacturer or passenger is responsible for crashes
